pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark contiguous regions are characterized by irregular polygonal shapes with highly serrated, jagged edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is largest on the upper flank and decreases in scale toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous branching graph of topological pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, becoming thinner and more fragmented near the ventral line.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck and shoulder ridge presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette consisting of short, dense, vertically-aligned hair bundles.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A clear structural gap or dip in the mane's continuous profile is visible at the transition point where the posterior neck meets the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized dark silhouette corresponding to an avian organism (likely an oxpecker) is visible perched on the dorsal ridge near the base of the neck.
